title: THE CAPO TEST
question: Does the SQ-03F.1 source-out-strength association reflect a broader property of the hotspot source neuron, rather than being driven by the hotspot edge itself or by a small number of dominant outgoing edges?

data_and_universe.graph: same conservative matched graph: verdict_corr == isomorphic and weight_m > 0 and weight_f > 0

hotspots.S: reuse exact SQ-03F/SQ-03F.1 top-1-percent membership by max integrated S
hotspots.C: reuse exact SQ-03F/SQ-03F.1 top-1-percent membership by max integrated C

data_and_universe.matching: deterministically reconstruct SQ-03F.1 exact 1:1 controls: same context_count, total_weight_decile, and abs_weight_difference_decile; without replacement; no widening

unit_and_duplicate_rule.repeated_sources: edge-pair summaries are primary; additionally report unique source counts and a descriptive unique-source sensitivity summary

primary_features.name: leave_one_edge_out_source_strength
primary_features.definition: source total outgoing mean-weight strength minus the focal edge mean_weight; if parallel rows exist, remove only the focal row

primary_features.name: leave_one_edge_out_mean_outgoing_weight
primary_features.definition: leave_one_edge_out_source_strength divided by number of other outgoing conservative edge rows; null if none

source_audit: fraction of hotspot edges sharing a source with another hotspot edge

interpretation_rules: If leave-one-edge-out source strength retains the SQ-03F.1 direction, the surviving source-strength association is not attributable solely to the focal hotspot edge.

If leave-one-edge-out mean outgoing weight is also higher while edge count remains similar, the association is compatible with broadly stronger outgoing weights rather than merely more outgoing edges.

If top-share/HHI metrics are higher, concentration into a few dominant outputs is a candidate explanation; if they are similar or lower while mean/median outgoing weight is higher, a diffuse high-throughput source background is more compatible with the observed pattern.
These are descriptive model-level interpretations only.

family_model.translation: Is the edge the boss, or does it merely belong to a source neuron running a larger operation?
family_model.firewall: Family Model language is downstream of evidence and has no scientific authority.

claim_boundary: SQ-03F.2 may describe source-level graph properties associated with the already-frozen hotspot sets under exact SQ-03F.1 matching. It cannot establish biological sex mechanisms, neuron classes, living-fly behavior, population effects, organism-level hierarchy, or financial utility.
